text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, Curren Chan ponders something alone in her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just adjust the exposure and contrast, add a warm filter… and finally a filter for my skin.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …I've really been editing pics like this for too long. I need to hurry and get my skin cleared up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan continues to battle with skin problems no one knows about.
